title: Most World Cup matches won
brief: Name the ten nations that have won the most matches at World Cup finals tournaments.
period: Every World Cup, 1930 to 2026. Shoot-outs count as draws.

notes.Mexico: Mexico are 11th with 21 wins, just outside.
notes.Russia: Russia (with the Soviet Union) have 19 wins, just outside.
notes.Germany: Germany's figures include West Germany (1950 to 1990) and the pre-war Germany team, as FIFA counts them; the slot takes Germany or West Germany.

checks: The current all-time table was rebuilt as the 29 May 2026 version of the same table plus every team's 2026 record from the 2026 tournament ranking (sourced to FIFA's competition summary): all 81 main rows agree. Germany's row also equals the sum of its Germany 1934-38, West Germany and Germany since 1994 sub-rows. Matches won in extra time count as wins; matches settled on penalties count as draws (the table's own convention).
